plan: 1. Load data.csv. 2. Filter age between 18 and 80 inclusive. 3. Drop rows with missing glucose_fu. 4. Compute overall mean and sample SD (n-1) of glucose_fu on remaining data; remove observations where |glucose_fu - mean| > 3*SD. 5. Split by diet into usual and mediterranean groups. 6. Compute n, mean, sample SD (n-1) for each group. 7. Compute mean_diff = mean(mediterranean) - mean(usual). 8. Run Welch's t-test (unequal variances), two-sided, on glucose_fu between mediterranean and usual. 9. Compute pooled SD = sqrt(((n1-1)*sd1^2+(n2-1)*sd2^2)/(n1+n2-2)), Cohen's d = mean_diff/pooled_sd. 10. Output JSON with all claim slots.
